concerns.text: The idea's methodology explicitly specifies a held-out test set of '20% of data', but the spec defers this to '[deferred] of data' / 'held-out [deferred] test set'. The [deferred] convention covers empirical measurements, not a design split ratio the source idea already fixed. State the 20% split (or justify a change).

The idea's methodology sketch requires 'Document all code and data preprocessing steps in reproducible Jupyter notebook'. No FR or user story covers reproducible documentation of the pipeline. Add a requirement or note the deliberate deferral to the plan stage.
